# Figures register

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-figures-index.mjs from the catalogues. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run build:figures`. -->

Every figure that can change: law, market prices and Planeir's own assumptions, each with its value, its source and when it was last checked. The in-app AI reads these through `getFigures`, and a weekly scheduled job keeps the market ones current. No figure is typed in anywhere else.

| Kind | Meaning | Who changes it |
|---|---|---|
| Law in force | Set by legislation or a Revenue or Department rule that is in force | Edited when the law changes, with its source |
| Announced law | Announced in a Budget or published as a Bill, not yet enacted | Edited when it is enacted or amended |
| Market | A price or rate that moves on its own, worked out from the quotes it was read from | The weekly job adds quotes; code does the arithmetic |
| Planeir assumption | A choice Planeir makes | A person only; a job never changes these |

Counts: Law in force 226, Announced law 32, Market 3, Planeir assumption 27. Total 288.

**Checked.** The day the value was read against its source. † means the figure has no check date of its own and shows the date its catalogue was last verified. ‡ means a Planeir choice with no review recorded, so the date shown is the day it was set.

**From.** The day the value takes effect. A dash means the source states no date. A rule that a later tax year carries over unchanged is listed once, for the year it first took effect.

Catalogues: Irish tax rules `ie-tax-2026.7`; Irish planning rules `ie-planning-rules-2026.02`; Social welfare rates `ie-social-welfare-2026.2`; House Purchase rules `house-purchase-rules-2026.10`; Planeir central assumptions `planeir-assumptions-1.7.0`; Market figures `ie-market-2026.1`.

## Market figures: how each value is worked out

Internal provenance. The provider names below are for the audit trail and are never shown to clients: a label, a basis or a source title never names one.

### Interest on money kept in an instant-access cash account, before DIRT

`ie.market.cash.instant_access_gross_rate` is **0.2% a year**. Mean of the quotes below, rounded to the nearest 0.001. Checked 2026-10-22, last changed 2026-10-13, reviewed every 35 days. Figure version `1.0.0`.

| Quote | Value | Quoted as | Effective | Read on |

| [AIB, Personal Demand Deposit Account](https://aib.ie/our-products/savings-and-deposits/Deposit-Rates) | 0.25% | AER and gross annual interest rate, variable | 2025-05-13 | 2026-10-22 |

### Interest rate used to illustrate mortgage repayments

`ie.market.mortgage.illustration_rate` is **3.5% a year**. Held as a standard planning assumption, 3.5% a year, as of 2026-07-11; not worked out from the quotes. The quotes below are the evidence for it. Checked 2026-10-22, last changed 2026-07-12, reviewed every 35 days. Figure version `1.0.0`.
